fact: In its September 2024 appraisal report the African Development Bank states that the state's information systems are not interoperable and that adoption of digital services stays low for lack of a coherent platform for exchange between public entities, and sets a target of one interoperability and data exchange platform against a baseline of zero.
title: Rapport d'évaluation de projet - Projet d'appui à la digitalisation de l'économie comorienne (PADEC)
publisher: Groupe de la Banque africaine de développement
